SELECT B.BUY_NUM, B.MEM_EMAIL, B.BUY_PRICE, B.BUY_DATE, D.BUY_DETAIL_NUM, D.BOOK_NUM, D.BUY_CNT, D.BUY_PRICE AS DETAIL_PRICE, BK.BOOK_TITLE, BI.UPLOAD_FILE_NAME FROM SHOP_BUY B LEFT JOIN BUY_DETAIL D ON B.BUY_NUM = D.BUY_NUM LEFT JOIN SHOP_BOOK BK ON D.BOOK_NUM = BK.BOOK_NUM LEFT JOIN BOOK_IMG BI ON BK.BOOK_NUM = BI.BOOK_NUM AND BI.IS_MAIN = 'Y'
AND B.MEM_EMAIL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{memEmail}, '%')
AND B.BUY_DATE >= #{startDate}
AND B.BUY_DATE <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
AND BK.BOOK_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bookTitle}, '%')
ORDER BY B.BUY_DATE DESC
SELECT CONCAT(MONTH(BUY_DATE), '월') AS label, SUM(BUY_PRICE) AS totalSales, COUNT(BUY_NUM) AS orderCount FROM SHOP_BUY WHERE YEAR(BUY_DATE) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(BUY_DATE) ORDER BY MONTH(BUY_DATE)

SELECT CONCAT(CEIL(DAY(BUY_DATE) / 7), '주차') AS label, SUM(BUY_PRICE) AS totalSales, COUNT(BUY_NUM) AS orderCount FROM SHOP_BUY WHERE YEAR(BUY_DATE) = #{year} AND MONTH(BUY_DATE) = #{month} GROUP BY CEIL(DAY(BUY_DATE) / 7) ORDER BY CEIL(DAY(BUY_DATE) / 7)
